$description: Native-speaker review status of every secondary-locale string (F-001 design §7.4.3, OQ-D8). check-i18n fails if a key is missing here. Use "needs-native-review" for placeholder or machine-assisted text, and { "reviewer": "<name>", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD" } once a native speaker has approved it. Language names are endonyms: each language is named in its own script in every locale.
